subject: Leadership pulse: launch readiness brief & timeline validation
messages:
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Anjali Shah <anjali.shah@atlashealth.com>
Cc: 
Date: Fri, 24 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Leadership pulse: launch readiness brief & timeline validation

Hi all,

As we lock the QBR pack this week I want a short pulse on the product/eng roadmap items that are gating Atlas Health's product launch (they're our priority pilot). High level ask: please confirm by EOD your status against the timeline in the attached RW-roadmap-v2.xlsx and call out any new risks that would shift the April->May cutover.

Quick background for Anjali (external): we're aligning the Redwood feature slices (inference routing, prefix cache warmup, and custom model pinning) with Atlas's integration plan. The attached sheet has the timeline we shared last week.

Please cover:
- What is on-track vs at-risk (single-line)
- If at-risk, impact (latency, availability, or feature scope) and mitigation (owner + ETA)
- Any procurement/legal blockers from Atlas side we should plan for

Attachments: RW-roadmap-v2.xlsx, launch-risk-register.csv

Thanks — short bullets are fine.

Rishi
Rishi Malhotra
Director, Product Operations
Redwood Inference

---
For context: this will be folded into the QBR slide deck (leadership-facing).
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>, Anjali Shah <anjali.shah@atlashealth.com>
Date: Fri, 24 Apr 2027 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Leadership pulse: launch readiness brief & timeline validation

Rishi / team / Anjali —

Short status from Product/Eng (owner in parentheses):

- Inference routing + canary fallbacks: ON-TRACK. Goal: low-latency fallback policy for non‑prod traffic before pilot. Owner: Monica (ETA: 2027-05-02). No infra blockers.

- Prefix/KV cache warmup: AT-RISK. Observed cache cold starts on long sequences in last internal run. Impact: 80–120ms added p95 for some requests; may affect Atlas peak testing. Mitigation: pre-warm job + increase warmup window; Owner: Irene (ETA: 2027-04-29).

- Custom model pinning (v1): ON-TRACK for inference correctness, LIMITED for autoscale resilience. Impact: autoscale may need extra buffer in first week post-launch; mitigation: temporary reserved burst capacity (dedicated) + aggressive monitoring. Owner: Vivek (ETA: 2027-05-05).

- SDK integration docs for Atlas: COMPLETE (shared link in Drive).

Attachments: launch-risk-register.csv (latest lines 12–18 updated with cache mitigation plan).

Action items:
1) Irene to run two warmup passes by 04/29 and report observed p95.
2) Vivek to validate burst pool sizing and confirm cost/approval by 05/01.
3) Rishi to include the above in the QBR one-pager.

Monica
Monica Patel
Head of Product
Redwood Inference
From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Anjali Shah <anjali.shah@atlashealth.com>
Date: Fri, 24 Apr 2027 12:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Leadership pulse: launch readiness brief & timeline validation

Thanks — quick update after the morning run.

- Warmup findings: the cold-path occurs when prefix length > 512 and batch skew is high. I ran a deterministic pre-warm pass and reduced p95 from ~120ms to ~40ms in our staging traces (see attached snapshot row in launch-risk-register.csv).
- Residual risk: customers with very bursty traffic (>500 concurrent long-seq requests) could still see >100ms; mitigation is twofold: 1) increase warmup window + background pre-warm job, 2) enable temporary reserved capacity for pilot (Vivek to confirm).

I attached the updated launch-risk-register.csv and a short exported trace snippet. I'll kick off the two additional pre-warm passes this afternoon and post results to the Drive link.

Irene
Irene Choi
Sr. Engineering Manager, Inference Runtime
Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Leadership pulse: launch readiness brief & timeline validation

Appreciate the quick updates — this is helpful. A few notes from Atlas: 

- Timeline: Procurement is on track to sign the SOW by 05/04 provided we get the cost delta for the reserved burst pool + a short note on how long we expect to need the buffer. Procurement (cc'd) asked for a line-item.
- Risk tolerances: Atlas's performance SLA tolerance is p95 < 250ms for end-user flows; your current mitigations look reasonable, but we need the change-control plan if we see regression post-rollout.
- Legal request: please attach the data retention and logging summary for pilot (our legal has a checklist).

Next steps:
1) Vivek — can you send the burst-pool cost estimate + recommended duration by EOD Monday 05/01?
2) Rishi — include the data retention summary in the QBR appendix (or point us to the doc).
3) Monica/Irene — please flag if there are any new functional regressions after the further warmup runs.

Anjali Shah
Head of Integrations
Atlas Health
